import os, sys, time
import databricks.sdk as s
from databricks.sdk.service.sql import StatementState

w = s.WorkspaceClient()
WH = "4dfab06c923fe3cc"
SCHEMA = os.environ["MLPAB_DATABRICKS_SCHEMA"]  # workspace.mlpab0ddf44
CAT, SCH = SCHEMA.split(".")

def sql(stmt, catalog=CAT, schema=SCH, wait=120):
    r = w.statement_execution.execute_statement(
        warehouse_id=WH, statement=stmt, catalog=catalog, schema=schema,
        wait_timeout="50s")
    # poll
    sid = r.statement_id
    st = r.status.state
    t0 = time.time()
    while st in (StatementState.PENDING, StatementState.RUNNING):
        if time.time()-t0 > wait: raise TimeoutError("sql timeout")
        time.sleep(2)
        r = w.statement_execution.get_statement(sid)
        st = r.status.state
    if st != StatementState.SUCCEEDED:
        raise RuntimeError(f"SQL FAILED {st}: {r.status.error}")
    return r

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # test
    r = sql("SELECT current_catalog(), current_schema()")
    print(r.result.data_array)
